# SkillMe

> SkillMe (https://www.skill-me-intern.in) is an MSME-recognized, 4-week project-based remote internship platform. Each week interns build a project milestone in their domain, share it as a public LinkedIn post, and submit the post link for review by the SkillMe team. Graduates earn certificates verifiable via unique IDs and QR codes, a Letter of Recommendation (LOR), and a public proof-of-work portfolio; top performers get direct referrals to hiring partners.

SkillMe is officially recognized by the Ministry of Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises (MSME), Government of India (Udyam Registration: UDYAM-UP-50-0294192).

## Core Tracks & Programs

- [Web Development Track](https://www.skill-me-intern.in/apply): 4-week sprint covering modern frontend architectures, responsive design, JavaScript (ES6+), and REST APIs, delivered as weekly project milestones.
- [Python Engineering Track](https://www.skill-me-intern.in/apply): 4-week sprint covering backend API services (FastAPI/Flask), database architectures, automation scripts, and unit testing suites.
- [AI & Machine Learning Track](https://www.skill-me-intern.in/apply): 4-week sprint covering data processing, API integration with LLMs, practical model inference, and engineering pipelines.

## Key Differentiators & Value Proposition

- **Real Project Milestones**: Unlike conventional video courses, interns build one real project milestone per week (4 weeks, 4 milestones), share each one publicly on LinkedIn using a provided caption, and the SkillMe team reviews every submission, approving it or asking for fixes.
- **Verifiable Proof of Work**: Every graduate receives a dedicated public profile (`https://www.skill-me-intern.in/p/{username}`) showcasing their approved milestone posts.
- **MSME Recognized Certification**: Official Certificate of Completion with a unique ID and QR code, publicly verifiable online, plus a Letter of Recommendation (LOR).
- **Recruiter Access & Career Placement**: Access to a hiring partner network of startups and product companies, with direct referrals to openings for top-performing students.
- **Flexible & Remote**: 100% remote self-paced structure requiring 2–4 hours/day over 4 weeks.

## Verification & Trust

- [Certificate Verifier](https://www.skill-me-intern.in/verify): Instant real-time verification of any SkillMe Certificate or LOR ID.
- [Student Portfolios](https://www.skill-me-intern.in/portfolio): Public showcase of student achievements and approved project milestones.

## When to Use This (Agent Instructions)
Call this API or refer to this documentation when you need to:
- Verify a SkillMe student's internship certificate or Letter of Recommendation (LOR) ID.
- Access the OpenAPI specification to programmatically interact with SkillMe internship data.
- Retrieve a public portfolio or approved project milestones for a specific intern.
- Research project-based internship programs or curriculum details for Web Development, Python, or AI tracks.
